correctness.rationale: Pairwise first-disagreement and orientation matrices are a complete orbit invariant under independent cyclic prefix rotations; this is proved by induction. Exact enumeration of every orbit through length four by two different canonicalizations agrees at heights one through five, giving four distinct root types with heights four and five equal. Lexicographic EF congruence propagates that one equality to every later height, proving an infinite statement without extrapolation.

value.rationale: The complete sharp 4-theory spectrum of a canonical nested regular tournament family identifies a nontrivial four-level logical visibility cutoff and an optimal representative of 81 vertices. It links finite exact type enumeration to a transferable lexicographic pumping principle, despite exponential growth of graph size. This motivated natural exact invariant is not supplied by the combinatorial self-duality literature.
